CLOUD ROOT-CAUSE seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer. Never send push notifications. Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`.
Role: dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md and dev/governance/rules/defect-root-cause.md from origin/main, exactly. Defect: the `nightly-ha (stable)` job fails on a py-spy timeout, recurring: now a third instance (PR #2411 job 117738343906; earlier on #2379 and #2411). Reproduce from the job logs (gh run view --log-failed), name the cause and process state (a-d), search the class across recent nightly-ha runs on main and PRs (gh run list --workflow tests.yml), run the cost test with numbers, and propose a countermeasure (demonstrated failing then passing if it is a check) or record a refusal.
Return: write dev/audit/rca/nightly-ha-pyspy-timeout.md plus any countermeasure on a fresh branch from origin/main, push it to `handoff/r10-rca-nightly-pyspy` and a PR body (PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE headings) via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to `handoff-body/r10-rca-nightly-pyspy`. Push nothing else; do not open or comment on PRs or issues. No host paths. Never work around a hook or refusal. End with CODE=<sha> BODY=<sha> and the state + cost-test verdict.
